evidence.quote:
Every Meridian deployment now requires a signed release
manifest before it ships.

We saw two unsigned artifacts reach staging
last quarter and that is the whole reason for the gate.

observations.why: Quinton establishes a mandatory procedural requirement (legitimate base) justified by referencing a past defect incident as the causal rationale (rational persuasion).

evidence.quote: signed release manifest required for Meridian deploys

observations.why: Formal structural recording of policy gate, scope, and ownership designating procedural governance authority.
